title: Mind, whose AI agents autonomously handle data loss prevention tasks, raised a $72M Series B, sources say at a $300M valuation, taking its total raised to $112M (Sophie Shulman/CTech)
summary: Sophie Shulman / CTech: Mind, whose AI agents autonomously handle data loss prevention tasks, raised a $72M Series B, sources say at a $300M valuation, taking its total raised to $112M — MIND has raised $112 million to date and reached a $10 million annual revenue run rate just 18 months after beginning to sell its product …
